per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to routine tasks (e.g., pulling up a student's record or changing a shift) in a few seconds, ideally less than five seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle batch operations, such as generating schedules, within a reasonable time frame, ideally not exceeding half a minute.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be able to handle concurrent usage by approximately ten to fifteen users during peak times without significant performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'system shall be able to handle all of the user requests/usage during business hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available during business hours with a target availability of ninety-five percent.
The system should be intuitive and require minimal training, ideally no more than one focused training day for regular users and a shorter orientation for adjuncts and site coordinators.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be compatible with common browsers and devices, including Mac, Windows, and older machines, without requiring special plugins or proprietary software.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'We must be able to interface with any HTML browser.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be easy to use, requiring no technical expertise from the users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be easy to use by the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement role-based access control, allowing program admins full access, site coordinators access to relevant details, and instructors access to rosters and schedule info.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Only authorized users shall have access to clinical site information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should restrict access to sensitive information, such as clinical site contract terms, contact info, student health, and background-check info, in accordance with university policies.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should integrate with the university's student records and HR or payroll systems to avoid manual data entry and ensure data consistency.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide audit trails to track changes made by users, including who changed what and when.
The system should prevent scheduling conflicts, such as double-booking students or assigning instructors who are already booked, and warn about missing clearances.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide automatic notifications to students, instructors, and site coordinators when schedules change, and allow follow-up on unconfirmed notifications.
The system should provide basic reports, such as daily clinical rosters, instructor assignments, and student progression summaries, to save time and effort.
The system should reduce the amount of paper usage by providing digital alternatives for schedules and other documents.
